unit: phocid species accounts stating that the external ear is absent

Phoca vitulina: Their large round heads that lack external ears, although their middle ear bones are large.
Odobenus rosmarus: This system closes their auditory meatus and only allows them to hear through their outer ear tube.
Condylura cristata: Its hearing seems to be excellent, as the external ear openings are much larger than those of other North American species.
